page_title: REN 2-0 MAR | Rennes v Marseille 17/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
88' Julien Stephan prepares a substitution. Arnaud Kalimuendo is replaced by Ibrahim Salah (Rennes).
88' Substitution. Djaoui Cisse (Rennes) on for Benjamin Bourigeaud.
84' Today's match ends for Amine Harit who will be replaced by Azzedine Ounahi (Marseille).
84' Jean-Louis Gasset decides to make a substitution. Pape Gueye will be replaced by Luis Henrique (Marseille).
84' Adrien Truffert comes off the pitch to be replaced by Alidu Seidu (Rennes).
83' A cross from Ismaila Sarr (Marseille) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.

81' What a great effort! Amine Harit (Marseille) decides to unleash a long-range shot. Despite hitting it very well, it scorches inches wide of the right post. We could have witnessed a magnificent goal. The ball goes out of play and Rennes will have a goal kick.
80' The referee is firm and issues Ismaila Sarr (Marseille) a deserved yellow card.
77' 2 - 0 Goal! Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Pau Lopez into the bottom right corner.
77' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
76' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
76' Pau Lopez (Marseille) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
75' Abdoul Bamo Meite (Marseille) is penalised for holding. Eric Wattellier signals a set piece. PENALTY! One of the players from Rennes is about to take a penalty kick. Let's see how this ends.
73' Close! A mistake by a defender gifts Faris Moumbagna (Marseille) a chance inside the box, but his efforts curls just around the right post.

73' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) produces a decent strike goalwards from the resulting set piece. His effort rattles the right post and the ball stays out of the net. The goalkeeper was quite lucky!
70' Baptiste Santamaria (Rennes) commits a rough foul. Eric Wattellier stops the game and makes a call. It's a free kick to Marseille in a dangerous position.
68' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jordan Veretout (Marseille) comes onto the pitch so that Geoffrey Kondogbia can be given a rest.
68' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Faris Moumbagna (Marseille) will replace Iliman Ndiaye.
66' Julien Stephan has decided to substitute Amine Gouiri and he is replaced by Desire Doue (Rennes).
66' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ludovic Blas trots off the pitch and is replaced by Azor Matusiwa (Rennes).
66' Pape Gueye (Marseille) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
64' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) makes a strong challenge and Eric Wattellier blows for a foul.
60' Jonathan Clauss (Marseille) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
57' Rennes take a short corner kick.
57' Amine Gouiri (Rennes) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The linesman makes the right call and Rennes will have a corner.
56' Pape Gueye (Marseille) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
55' Pape Gueye (Marseille) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
54' The resulting set piece from Marseille is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
54' The ball is cleared after Amine Gouiri (Rennes) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee points to the corner flag and Rennes will take a corner.
50' Half-chance! Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) plays a pass into the box, but Steve Mandanda reacts well to snuff out the attack.
49' Adrien Truffert (Rennes) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.

47' Jonathan Clauss (Marseille) fancies his chances and unleashes a powerful shot from the edge of the box, but the keeper just watches it go high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Rennes will have a goal kick.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' Eric Wattellier blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' Ismaila Sarr (Marseille) heads the ball towards goal, but his effort is saved by the goalkeeper.
45+1' Marseille have been awarded a corner kick.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Martin Terrier (Rennes) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
44' Guela Doue (Rennes) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
40' Jonathan Clauss (Marseille) sends a cross into the box, but Steve Mandanda comes off his line to gather the ball.
38' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Amine Harit (Marseille) was quite harsh and Eric Wattellier didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
35' Amine Harit (Marseille) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
35' Amine Harit (Marseille) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger. Marseille have a corner.
34' The corner from Amine Harit (Marseille) is hurriedly cleared.
31' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) is able to continue to play.
30' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
29' A clumsy foul by Christopher Wooh (Rennes) and Eric Wattellier blows his whistle.
28' A quickly taken corner by Rennes.

27' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play. Rennes win a corner kick.
26' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Amine Harit (Marseille). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

25' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the bottom left corner. It's a great effort but an even better save from Steve Mandanda, who tips the ball around the post.
21' 1 - 0 Martin Terrier (Rennes) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and coolly sends the ball into the back of the net.
20' Amine Harit (Marseille) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Rennes will have a goal kick.
20' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) unleashes a long-range free kick, but the goalkeeper does well to make a fine save.
18' Eric Wattellier couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Pape Gueye (Marseille) and blew his whistle.
18' Flag up against Ismaila Sarr (Marseille). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
15' Ismaila Sarr (Marseille) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Steve Mandanda, who smothers the ball.
13' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) commits a rough challenge and Eric Wattellier blows his whistle for a foul.
12' Amine Harit (Marseille) goes for goal but he blazes his shot well over the top.
9' Guela Doue (Rennes) approaches the edge of the box with intent and shoots, but Pau Lopez rushes out to narrow the angle and smothers the ball. Good goalkeeping!
7' Amine Gouiri (Rennes) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Marseille.
4' The resulting corner from Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
2' Iliman Ndiaye (Marseille) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Marseille will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Eric Wattellier.
